description: Tamil Nadu has introduced Nalam TN, a digital healthcare platform that enables AI-powered WhatsApp outpatient registration, online hospital appointments, and transparent donations to government hospitals. Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay also inaugurated healthcare infrastructure worth INR 139.47 Cr and issued appointment orders to 2,144 healthcare personnel.
body_lead: Tamil Nadu Rolls Out Nalam TN, an AI-Powered WhatsApp Platform for Seamless OP Registration The Chief Minister also inaugurated medical infrastructure and equipment worth INR 139.47 Cr, covering new patient wards, hospital buildings, and diagnostic facilities across the state. Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay has launched Nalam TN, a statewide digital health platform that combines AI-powered WhatsApp outpatient registration, online appointment booking, and transparent hospital donations into a single system.
